entries.title: The Mark of Kri

emulation.emulator: PS2-on-PS4 emulator; PCSX2 for owned PS2 discs
emulation.notes: Use the PS4 classic for the official enhanced route, or PCSX2 for owned discs if you need emulator configuration control.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official 1080p PS4 conversion, with PCSX2 as a configurable preservation alternative.

primary.why: The PS4 classic is the best official version because it converts the PS2 original with 1080p up-rendering, trophies, Share Play, Remote Play, and digital manual support while preserving the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Buy or access The Mark of Kri on PlayStation Store/PlayStation Plus Premium and play the PS4 classic release.

all_releases.reason: skip: historically original, but the PS4 classic adds official up-rendering and trophy support.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2 Classics digital release before the PS4 conversion.
all_releases.reason: skip: older digital route, superseded by the PS4 classic with 1080p up-rendering and trophies.

all_releases.fidelity: PS2 classic converted to PS4 with 1080p up-rendering, trophies, Share Play, Remote Play, and digital manual support.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity official version and current digital route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS4 classic preserves the PS2 game while adding official emulator enhancements; no exclusive-content split was identified.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a PS2 conversion for PS4, not a remake; converted titles may play differently and may not support PS2 peripherals.
